fertilizer_guidance: Typical N:P:K 100:50:50 kg/ha. Apply all P and K and a third of N at transplanting; the rest of N in two splits at tillering and panicle initiation. Add zinc sulphate where zinc is deficient. Adjust to your Soil Health Card.
Typical N:P:K 120:60:40 kg/ha. Apply half N with all P and K at sowing; the rest of N at first irrigation (crown root stage). Adjust to your Soil Health Card.
Typical N:P:K 120:60:40 kg/ha. A third of N with all P and K at sowing; remaining N at knee-high and tasselling stages. Adjust to your Soil Health Card.
Typical N:P:K 60:30:30 kg/ha under irrigation, about 40:20:0 when rainfed. Half N at sowing, half about 30 days later.
Typical N:P:K 80:40:40 kg/ha. Half N with all P and K at sowing; the rest 30 days after sowing.
Typical N:P:K 60:30:30 kg/ha. Half N with all P and K at sowing; the rest 25-30 days later.
Pulses fix their own nitrogen: typical N:P:K 20:40:20 kg/ha, all at sowing. Treat seed with Rhizobium culture.
Rajma fixes little nitrogen: typical N:P:K 80:60:40 kg/ha, half N at sowing and half at 30 days.
Typical N:P:K 20:50:20 kg/ha at sowing. Treat seed with Rhizobium and PSB cultures.
Typical N:P 10:40 kg/ha at sowing. Very drought tolerant; avoid waterlogging.
Typical N:P:K 20:40:20 kg/ha, all at sowing. Treat seed with Rhizobium culture.
Typical N:P:K 20:40:20 kg/ha, all at sowing. Treat seed with Rhizobium culture.
Typical N:P:K 20:40:20 kg/ha, all at sowing.
Typical N:P:K 25:50:45 kg/ha at sowing. Apply gypsum (about 400 kg/ha) at flowering for calcium and sulphur.
Typical N:P:K 30:60:40 kg/ha plus 20 kg sulphur, all at sowing. Treat seed with Rhizobium culture.
Typical N:P:K 80:40:40 kg/ha plus 40 kg sulphur. Half N at sowing, half at first irrigation.
Typical N:P:K 100:50:50 kg/ha for hybrids; N in three splits (sowing, square formation, flowering). Adjust to your Soil Health Card.
Typical N:P:K 60:30:30 kg/ha; half N at sowing, the rest in two splits at 3 and 6 weeks.
Typical N:P:K 250:100:120 kg/ha. All P and K at planting; N in three to four splits up to 120 days.
Typical N:P:K 100:50:50 kg/ha plus sulphur. Half N at transplanting, the rest at 30 and 45 days. Stop irrigation 2 weeks before harvest.
Typical N:P:K 150:80:100 kg/ha. Half N with all P and K at planting; the rest at earthing up (about 30 days).
Typical N:P:K 120:60:60 kg/ha (more for hybrids). Half N at transplanting; the rest at 30 and 50 days. Calcium helps prevent blossom-end rot.
Typical N:P:K 100:60:60 kg/ha; half N at sowing, half at vine spread.
Typical N:P:K 100:60:60 kg/ha; half N at sowing, half at vine spread.
Nutrient needs are per plant (roughly 200 g N, 60 g P, 300 g K per plant per cycle) in monthly splits. Follow your horticulture department schedule.
Doses depend on tree age; for a bearing tree roughly 1 kg N, 0.5 kg P, 1 kg K per year after harvest, with farmyard manure.
Doses are vineyard specific and split after pruning; follow your horticulture department or NRC Grapes schedule.
Doses depend on plant age; split applications after bahar treatment. Follow your horticulture department schedule.
Doses depend on tree age; apply manure and NPK in early spring. Follow your horticulture department schedule.
Doses depend on tree age; split NPK in two to three applications around flowering. Follow your horticulture department schedule.
Roughly 200 g each of N, P and K per plant per year in bimonthly splits.
For a bearing palm roughly 500 g N, 320 g P, 1200 g K per year in two splits, with organic manure.
Doses depend on plant age and shade; follow the Coffee Board schedule (pre-blossom, post-blossom and monsoon splits).
